name: cursor-relay-mcp
description: Durable, model-selected Cursor Agent delegation through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate durable tasks to a chosen Cursor model.
interface.longDescription: Discover account models and delegate local workspace tasks to Cursor Agent with durable runs, polling, restart recovery, bounded events, timeouts, and structured errors.
defaultPrompt: Use Cursor Relay with an explicit model and a permission matching the user's request: read-only for review, workspace-write for requested code changes. Let Cursor inspect and edit the authorized workspace itself instead of pasting source into the request. For write runs, follow wait_run and read_events, track modified files, and verify those files locally before reporting completion.
